remap_gemma_params: remap Gemma checkpoint parameters from original format to the new module layout without a separate mlp module
nest_flat_params: nest a flat dictionary of Gemma parameters into a deeply nested dict-of-dicts structure using slash-separated paths
flatten_and_remap_params: flatten a nested Gemma parameter pytree and remap parameter names back to the old checkpoint format
get_attention_pattern_len: get the attention pattern length from stacked layer checkpoint parameters by finding the maximum attention type index
unstack_params: unstack Gemma checkpoint parameters from a stacked attention pattern format into individual per-layer parameters
